flawless: Every creature you lost made me stronger. You were most generous, dear guest.
Not a drop of my blood spilled, and the evening has only begun.
The Baron would be appalled. Fighting so poorly in the presence of a Sengir!
solid: You drew a little blood. Rude, but I understand the impulse.
A few wounds for a fine vintage of victory. I'll take that trade.
close: Oh, my. You nearly ruined my best cloak. And my unlife.
I am parched, and you are still breathing. A night to remember.
